Calculate basic diversity statistics

Source: R/faststats.R
faststats.Rd

This function calculates allelic richness, heterozygosity, and inbreeding coefficients for specified sites within genetic groups. Data is filtered based on genetic group (minimum number of loci, minimum minor allele frequency, and maximum missingness per locus) and minimum number of individuals per site.

Usage

faststats(
  gt,
  genetic_group_variable,
  site_variable,
  minimum_n = 3,
  minimum_loci = 50,
  maf = 0.05,
  max_missingness = 0.3,
  get_CI_loci_resampling = FALSE,
  loci_resample_n = NULL,
  get_CI_individual_resampling = FALSE,
  individual_resample_n = NULL,
  boots = 100,
  CI_alpha = 0.05,
  run_HWE_test = FALSE,
  return_locus_stats = FALSE
)

Arguments

gt

Genotype matrix where individuals are rows and loci are columns, coded as 0=aa, 1=aA, 2=AA.

genetic_group_variable

Vector of genetic group IDs for each individual (same length as number of rows in gt). Can represent species, subspecies, or other biologically relevant structure groups.

site_variable

Vector of group IDs (sites) for each individual (same length as number of rows in gt).

minimum_n

Minimum number of individuals required per site (sites with fewer individuals will be filtered out).

minimum_loci

Minimum number of loci required to proceed with analysis for each genetic group (genetic groups with fewer loci will be skipped).

maf

Minimum minor allele frequency filter.

max_missingness

Maximum proportion of missing data allowed per locus (loci with higher missingness will be filtered out).

get_CI_loci_resampling

Get confidence intervals for Ho, He, Fis, using bootstrapping by resampling loci (as in hierfstat::boot.ppfis)

loci_resample_n

Number of loci to resample if bootstrapping, defaults to site n.

get_CI_individual_resampling

Get confidence intervals for Ho, He, Fis, using bootstrapping by resampling individuals (as in diveRsity::basicstats)

individual_resample_n

Number of samples to resample if bootstrapping, defaults to site n.

boots

Number of bootstraps to get confidence intervals.

CI_alpha

Alpha value for confidence intervals, defaults to 0.05 (2.5%, 97.5% CIs).

run_HWE_test

Specify whether to statistically test if allele frequencies differ from Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium.

return_locus_stats

Specify whether to return p values for each locus from HWE testing. Setting this to TRUE also runs the HWE test (run_HWE_test = TRUE).

Value

A data frame with the following columns (or, if return_locus_stats = TRUE, a list with this data frame as summary and per-locus HWE p-values as locus_HWE):

group

Genetic group ID (e.g., species, subspecies).

site

Site ID corresponding to the sample location.

Ar

Rarefied allelic richness: the expected number of alleles per locus in a sample of the smallest size observed at that locus among the sites retained for the genetic group, averaged across loci (see calculate_rarified_Ar). Comparable among sites within a genetic group.

Ho

Observed heterozygosity.

He

Expected heterozygosity under Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium within the site_variable.

uHe

Unbiased expected heterozygosity (corrected for small sample size).

Fis

Inbreeding coefficient (Fis = 1 - Ho / He).

Gst

Site-level gene diversity differentiation in the sense of Nei (1973), (Ht - Hs) / Ht, where Hs is the site's He and Ht is the He of all individuals in the genetic group.

Fst

Population-specific Fst of Weir & Goudet (2017) for the site, relative to the other sites retained for the genetic group (see calculate_Fst). NA if the group has only one retained site.

uFis

Unbiased inbreeding coefficient (uFis = 1 - Ho / uHe).

loci

Number of loci used in the analysis for that group-site combination.

n

Number of individuals sampled at the site for the given group.

*_ci.*%, *_ci.*%

Lower and upper confidence intervals for Fis, Ho, and He, generated via bootstrapping. Column prefixes indicate the statistic (e.g., loci_f.2.5%, loci_he.97.5%).

HWE_p

P-value from Fisher's method combining Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium tests across loci (HardyWeinberg::HWExact).

Details

Monomorphic sites and comparability. Statistics are calculated from the loci that pass the filters within each genetic group. With maf > 0 (the default) these are polymorphic loci only, and most SNP-calling pipelines output only polymorphic sites in any case. Ho, He, uHe and Ar are therefore SNP-level values: they are comparable among sites within a genetic group, which share the same loci, but they are not genome-wide heterozygosity and should not be compared with values from other datasets or from other genetic groups, which retain different loci. Fis, uFis, Gst and Fst are ratios that do not change when monomorphic loci are added (exactly for complete data, approximately with missing data), so they can be compared more broadly.

References

Nei, M. (1973). Analysis of gene diversity in subdivided populations. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 70(12), 3321–3323. https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.70.12.3321

Weir, B. S., & Goudet, J. (2017). A unified characterization of population structure and relatedness. Genetics, 206(4), 2085–2103. https://doi.org/10.1534/genetics.116.198424

Kalinowski, S. T. (2004). Counting alleles with rarefaction: private alleles and hierarchical sampling designs. Conservation Genetics, 5(4), 539–543. https://doi.org/10.1023/B:COGE.0000041021.91777.1a
